name: PMI Agile Certified Practitioner
name_ja: PMIアジャイル認定実務者

logistics.format: Computer-based multiple-choice exam at Pearson VUE

formal: 21 contact hours of training in agile practices
12 months of general project experience within last 5 years
8 months of agile project experience within last 3 years

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Verified agile experience across frameworks and Japanese availability support associate delivery coordination at two years; knowledge-only assessment and nontechnical scope do not establish security-program ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Verified project and agile experience across several frameworks supports associate delivery coordination at the two-year profile. The multiple-choice exam and non-security scope do not substantiate professional technical-security ownership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded verified project and agile experience plus multiple-framework coverage support associate delivery-method knowledge. Multiple-choice testing and no technical-security scope prevent professional security placement.
